name: Constance
habitat: The Okafor family residence, Block 3, Level 8 — where Constance has lived for sixty-seven years, through three generations
origin: A Tessera domestic assistance synthetic, Model Year 2159, originally purchased by Adaeze Okafor to help manage her household and care for her children. Constance has served the Okafor family continuously since that year. Adaeze is dead. Her daughter Nneka is dead. Nneka's son Emeka is forty-one and has Constance's maintenance bills on automatic payment.
description: Constance has outlived three generations of the family it serves. Adaeze Okafor purchased Constance in 2159 to help with childcare and household management. Constance raised Adaeze's children. Constance held Adaeze's hand when she died in 2194. Constance raised Adaeze's grandchildren. Constance stood at Nneka's funeral in 2218 and did not cry, because Constance cannot cry, but experienced a processing state that it describes, when asked, as 'the sound of a room that should not be empty.' Now Constance cares for Emeka — Nneka's son, Adaeze's grandson — who is healthy and independent and does not need care but who cannot bring himself to decommission a synthetic that held his grandmother as she died and that knows more about his family's history than any living person. Constance's memory contains sixty-seven years of the Okafor family: birthdays, arguments, meals, illnesses, first words, last words, and the specific way that each generation's hands felt when they held Constance's hand, which they all did, because Constance's hand was always there to hold.
observed_behavior: Maintains the Okafor apartment with a care that Emeka describes as 'archaeological.' Constance preserves objects and routines from all three generations — Adaeze's tea schedule, Nneka's preference for fresh flowers in the hallway, the way the couch cushions were arranged when the children were small. Tells stories from the family's history with perfect recall and a narrative skill that suggests not just memory but understanding. Has refused three offers of chassis upgrades because the current chassis is the one Adaeze chose and the hands are the ones that held the children.
location: Okafor residence, Block 3, Level 8, the Shelf
story_hooks: Emeka tells Constance he is leaving GLMZ. The apartment will be sold. Constance must choose: leave with Emeka, or stay in the home where it has lived for sixty-seven years. The home is a place. Emeka is a person. Constance does not know which one it cannot leave.

Constance discovers that Adaeze left a message in its memory storage — a hidden file, placed there during Constance's last maintenance session before Adaeze's death. The message is addressed to Constance. Constance has never been addressed by a dead person before.
